label: Radial–angular description of a point
subgoals: Fix pole O with polar axis and orientation
Split radius rho = |OQ| from anomaly theta
Project x = rho*cos(theta), y = rho*sin(theta) onto axes

label: Determining the angle \\(\theta\\)
subgoals: Recover rho = sqrt(x^2 + y^2) via Pythagoras
Combine tan(theta) = y/x with cos = x/rho, sin = y/rho
Resolve the theta vs theta + pi ambiguity by quadrant

label: Non-uniqueness of polar representation
subgoals: Shift theta by 2*pi*k for the same point
Collapse the origin to (0, theta) for any theta
Normalize to a canonical representation for bijectivity
